idadp.title: IDADP - Corn Disease Image Description Dataset
idadp.role: Whole-source holdout. Not added to active model training.
idadp.caveat: Ear-rot category requires expert differential review against smuts. Healthy category contains leaves, not healthy ears. Machine-generated image descriptions are not used as RAG advice.

ecuador.title: CornLeafDiseaseCollection
ecuador.split: Publisher Data.csv: BOLIVAR training; TOSAGUA validation; CHONE held-out test. Cross-site duplicates quarantined.
ecuador.caveat: common rust (Southern rust) is inconsistent in publisher description; retain as unresolved rust.

anhui.title: Corn Leaf Disease Recognition Dataset
anhui.role: Entire source reserved for cross-source evaluation
anhui.caveat: This is the public subset, not the full 2725-image study dataset. Own-Spot and Sheath-Blight remain unresolved.

inat_smut.title: iNaturalist research-grade Mycosarcoma maydis observations
inat_smut.license: Per-photo CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA; exact license and attribution in receipts
inat_smut.caveat: Community identification and assistant visual organ triage, not independent expert/laboratory diagnosis. Observer groups kept in one partition.

inat_maize.title: iNaturalist Zea mays observations for negative-control review
inat_maize.license: Per-photo CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA; exact license and attribution in receipts
inat_maize.caveat: Species identification does not imply health; only visually reviewed exposed ears enter the no-visible-galls class.

cds.title: Corn Disease and Severity Dataset
cds.caveat: OSF API node_license is null; license/permission needs clarification before adding to the training corpus.

plant_scanner.title: Plant-scanner Ustilago maydis infection study
plant_scanner.status: Research reference; full data available on author request, not acquired
plant_scanner.caveat: Laboratory video frames of seedlings differ from field photographs of affected ears.
